calculation.description: Ranks assets contrarily to their preceding five-session move, scaled by trailing 20-session realized volatility. The one-session shift ensures only completed observations are used. Positive values favor assets with recent losses and lower realized risk.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stable across all three chronological thirds; conservative interpretation warranted because the cross-section has 15 assets and signal coverage is reduced by the volatility warm-up and asset history availability.
